author: FoidHunter88
quote: Honestly garbage. I was hoping that corpo greed > woke **** would save this game but apparently not. Game is woke trash. Female ncps randomly saying "men are subhuman" or "kill all men" or Lucia will say "as you should" if you open the car door for her... You can tell it was made by a bunch of subhuman feminists/misandrists. Even if I ignore the blatant misandry and wokeism in this game, it's still garbage because bugs are everywhere you turn. You cannot shoot up gay bars or run over feminist crowds, you cannot steal cars in your neighbourhood or even pull out a weapon. If you crash a plane into a building nothing happens. The plane doesn't even break... This game is the worst. Half the budget went into bribing review critics and the other half was probably kept by Strauss Zelnick because damn, this game is ass.
